notes:
Updates itself from now on: it tells you when a new version is ready and installs it when you close (Help > Check for Updates).
Round-overs on top edges are cut now (a corner rounder, or a ball mill if your crib has none).
Hole table with no room on the sheet asks: new sheet, bigger sheet, or cancel.
About 100 fixes from a full review: tool paths, the Make G-code wizard, sketches, drawings, assemblies, the installer.
Lofts and sweeps that took 30+ minutes to make G-code now take 1 to 6.
BEZ CAM's own code is open source now (GPL-3.0).
